name: Mycelium terraces (mushrooms)
description: Two mushroom rows on mycelium per path (mushrooms stay on mycelium at any light level in vanilla). SkyPilot reference layout derived from vanilla block-placement rules; it is not a copy of any community design. Check the Garden rules in-game before committing materials.
movement: Move to the next path (+Z by 3)
harvest_direction: Along X; both mushroom rows next to the path
lighting_notes: Mycelium lets mushrooms stay at any light level (vanilla rule), so no lighting changes are needed.
build_order: Alternate red and brown mushrooms by row if you farm both.
